title: AES unpad errors discarded with |_| in decrypt.rs
description: decrypt.rs decrypt_aes128_cbc and decrypt_aes256_cbc use .map_err(|_| SmimeError::Other("AES-CBC unpad error")) — the original unpad error (block-padding crate's UnpadError enum) is discarded. The unpad error only has one meaningful variant (InvalidLength) so the information loss is minimal, but a SAFETY comment or at least .map_err(|e| SmimeError::Other(format!("AES-CBC unpad: {e}"))) would preserve the error type for debugging.
